workResult.summary: Executed only Skill 04 Research Analysis after fail-closed admission, deterministic validation of the authoritative generated Analysis prompt bundle, complete reading of all seven required control/editorial/evidence sources, a durable same-date Wake Receipt, repository-granted global-serial execution authority and a verified Worker Claimed event. Consumed only the three completed 2026-08-15 Reading Results and produced exactly three Research Objects. Q-20260815-01 concludes that resumable digital employees should separate history/provenance admission, framework-owned protocol-state admission, exact action-occurrence binding and independently authorized human approval; the selected implementation establishes strong protocol-state and occurrence boundaries but not trusted ordinary history or confirmer authorization. Q-20260815-02 concludes that delegated agent work needs both stable lifecycle identity for the delegated occurrence and a semantic return contract for successful completion; transport termination alone is insufficient, while cross-framework identity, remote durability and effect recovery remain separate contracts. Q-20260815-03 concludes that handoff safety must distinguish execution ownership, routing ownership and external-effect ownership; bounded local cancellation and registry retirement can revoke local routing without proving underlying work or external effects have terminated. No article drafting, visualization, Publication Candidate creation or publication was performed.
workResult.summary_zh: 在完成 Fail-closed Admission、权威 Generated Analysis Prompt Bundle 的确定性校验、全部 7 个 Required Control/Editorial/Evidence Source 的完整读取、同日 Wake Receipt 持久核验、仓库授予的全局串行执行权与 Worker Claimed 核验后，仅执行 Skill 04 Research Analysis。只消费 2026-08-15 当日三份已完成 Reading Result，并恰好形成三份 Research Object。Q-20260815-01 的判断是：可恢复数字员工应分离 History/Provenance Admission、框架自有 Protocol-state Admission、精确 Action-occurrence Binding 与独立授权的 Human Approval；所选实现建立了较强的 Protocol-state 与 Occurrence Boundary，但没有证明普通历史可信或 Confirmer 已授权。Q-20260815-02 的判断是：Delegated Agent Work 同时需要稳定的 Delegation Lifecycle Identity 与定义成功完成的 Semantic Return Contract；仅有 Transport Termination 不足，而 Cross-framework Identity、Remote Durability 与 Effect Recovery 仍是独立合同。Q-20260815-03 的判断是：Handoff Safety 必须区分 Execution Ownership、Routing Ownership 与 External-effect Ownership；有界的本地 Cancellation 与 Registry Retirement 可以撤销本地 Routing，但不能证明底层工作或外部 Effect 已经终止。未执行文章撰写、可视化、Publication Candidate 创建或发布。

researchObjects.judgment: Resumability should separate imported-history provenance, runtime-owned protocol-state admission, exact occurrence binding and human authorization; structurally valid history or confirmation is not automatically authoritative or authorized.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 可恢复性应分离导入历史 Provenance、Runtime 自有 Protocol-state Admission、精确 Occurrence Binding 与 Human Authorization；结构有效的历史或确认并不会自动成为权威状态或已授权批准。

researchObjects.judgment: Reliable delegated-agent work needs both stable lifecycle identity for the exact delegation and a task-specific semantic terminal contract; transport closure alone cannot prove successful completion.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 可靠的 Delegated-agent Work 同时需要精确委派的稳定 Lifecycle Identity 与 Task-specific Semantic Terminal Contract；Transport Closure 本身不能证明工作成功完成。

researchObjects.judgment: Safe handoff requires separate evidence for execution, routing and external-effect ownership; bounded cancellation and registry retirement can release local ownership without proving residual work or provider-side effects are closed.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 安全 Handoff 需要分别证明 Execution、Routing 与 External-effect Ownership；Bounded Cancellation 与 Registry Retirement 可以释放本地 Ownership，但不能证明 Residual Work 或 Provider-side Effect 已关闭。
